final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS z, s.insurstat AS ins, AVG(p.remaingb) AS rem, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS d FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(rem) AS m FROM s1) SELECT s1.z, s1.ins, s1.rem, s1.d, s1.rem / NULLIF(s2.m, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s1.rem / NULLIF(s2.m, 0)) IS NULL, s1.rem / NULLIF(s2.m, 0) DESC LIMIT 10
